about: llama.cpp builds this adapter drives, as ggml-org publishes them: each asset of a tested build with the size and SHA-256 GitHub lists for it. A build is tested when llama.cpp's llama.h, ggml.h, ggml-backend.h and gguf.h at that build declare what src/sys.rs declares. Add a build here, newest first, after running the adapter's tests on it. A build lists its archives for the platforms it was tested on, and is a tested build on those alone: one that was not run on Windows has no Windows archive, and Windows installs the newest that has.
